lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What's he saying though, I mean what's words is he using? Is he swearing at her, what is he saying?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He told her to shut her mouth up.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Is he telling her that he's gonna kill her, is he telling her he's gonna let her go, what's he telling her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he was gonna kill her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So you tie her up, then what happens?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then we get the other rope and tie her legs up.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How'd you do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Around the bottom, like where the

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Show me on you where he does that, where you guys do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Right here.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who ties her legs up?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He does.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do you help? Otherwise she's gonna kick.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you help or not, yes or no?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, tell me how you did that.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I held, I held her feet down.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Held her feet down. (Brendan nods “yes”) And what did Steve do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He tied her legs up.
